title: Inside each section of the waiting page (Blocking, Whenever, Answered and the rest), items sort newest first
why: Owner 14:49 CST Nov 18, in session chat: the sections he means are the ones on the page, such as Answered and Blocking; their sub-sections should be sorted by newness. He asked whether that was part of the page's earlier work.
source: owner session chat 14:40 and 14:49 CST Nov 18
note: Page rule today (skill waiting-page; page.html line 1394, owner ruling page-newest-first, 2026-11-12 21:37 CST): newest first inside a tier, but rank leads, and inside a tier new items come before seen ones. Measured 14:50 CST from triage's copy of the page items (not the live page): Blocking has 7 open items, none ranked; Whenever has 25 open, 2 ranked (n 240 added Nov 4, n 324 added Nov 7), so those two sit above newer items. Seen-versus-new order also overrides date. Not measured: how the Answered section orders its groups on the live page. Options for the owner: clear the two ranks (triage can do it); or drop rank and the new-first split so each section is pure newest first (page change, designer first). Triage asked the owner in chat.
